user.title: Connect Edge of Infinity
user.description: Use local for the installed add-on, or enter the Edge app API URL. Live, recordings and events dashboard cards are registered automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Edge of Infinity

abort.already_configured: Edge of Infinity is already configured

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish the Edge update
restart_required.description:
The Edge of Infinity add-on installed integration version {installed}, but Home Assistant is still running {running}. Until Home Assistant restarts, the Live, recordings and events dashboard cards may not load or play.

Go to Settings → System, choose Restart Home Assistant, then reload the dashboard.
